title: 雙曲拱壩拱座分析
titleEn: Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction
summary: 本課以雙曲拱壩拱座分析為入口，深入拱推力、岸坡楔體與壩岩相容的三維判讀。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams as its entry point, this course examines three-dimensional interpretation of arch thrust, abutment wedges and dam-rock compatibility. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄拱膜力初估」與「拱與懸臂分擔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thin-arch membrane estimate" and "Arch and cantilever load sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「薄拱膜力初估」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thin-arch membrane estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。真實壩體同時有懸臂彎曲、變厚與非圓形幾何，不能只用單一半徑設計。 假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄拱膜力初估」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. Thin circular-arch membrane action gives an initial scale, while real dams also have cantilever bending, variable thickness and noncircular geometry. Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thin-arch membrane estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「薄拱膜力初估」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thin-arch membrane estimate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄拱膜力初估
knowledge.text: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。真實壩體同時有懸臂彎曲、變厚與非圓形幾何，不能只用單一半徑設計。
knowledge.textEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. Thin circular-arch membrane action gives an initial scale, while real dams also have cantilever bending, variable thickness and noncircular geometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「雙曲拱壩拱座分析」的「薄拱膜力初估：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「水庫數據調度桌」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Thin-arch membrane estimate: mechanism and system paths” in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Reservoir data planning desk” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「薄拱膜力初估」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thin-arch membrane estimate" is correct?
options: 薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。
雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。
拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
optionsEn: Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam.
A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature.
Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄拱膜力初估」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thin-arch membrane estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄拱膜力初估」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thin-arch membrane estimate", which statement holds?
options: 岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。
完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
optionsEn: High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄拱膜力初估」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thin-arch membrane estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。分開報告拱冠與拱座附近的彎曲應力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions. Report bending stresses near the crown and abutments as separate quantities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以薄拱膜力初估編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thin-arch membrane estimate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。分開報告拱冠與拱座附近的彎曲應力。
knowledge.textEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions. Report bending stresses near the crown and abutments as separate quantities.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以薄拱膜力初估編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thin-arch membrane estimate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄拱膜力初估」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thin-arch membrane estimate"?
options: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。
optionsEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
quiz.explanation: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄拱膜力初估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thin-arch membrane estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。
knowledge.textEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄拱膜力初估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thin-arch membrane estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。
拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression.
Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱與懸臂分擔」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch and cantilever load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。分擔比例由剛度與邊界形成，不是可任意指定以降低應力的設計選項。 假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱與懸臂分擔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. Relative stiffness and boundaries determine sharing; the proportions cannot be arbitrarily chosen to make stresses smaller. Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arch and cantilever load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱與懸臂分擔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arch and cantilever load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱與懸臂分擔
knowledge.text: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。分擔比例由剛度與邊界形成，不是可任意指定以降低應力的設計選項。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. Relative stiffness and boundaries determine sharing; the proportions cannot be arbitrarily chosen to make stresses smaller.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱與懸臂分擔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arch and cantilever load sharing" is correct?
options: 拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。
optionsEn: Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement.
quiz.explanation: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱與懸臂分擔」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch and cantilever load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拱與懸臂分擔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arch and cantilever load sharing", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN。
裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。
接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN.
Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities.
Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱與懸臂分擔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch and cantilever load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。確認兩路徑分擔總和仍等於原始水壓荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone. Verify that the sum of both load paths still equals applied water loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以拱與懸臂分擔編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for arch and cantilever load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。確認兩路徑分擔總和仍等於原始水壓荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone. Verify that the sum of both load paths still equals applied water loading.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以拱與懸臂分擔編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for arch and cantilever load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱與懸臂分擔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arch and cantilever load sharing"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
把峰值地面加速度乘壩重就能完整代表三維地震反應。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness.
Peak ground acceleration times dam weight completely represents three-dimensional earthquake response.
quiz.explanation: 核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱與懸臂分擔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arch and cantilever load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。
knowledge.textEn: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拱與懸臂分擔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arch and cantilever load sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds.
quiz.explanation: 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
